headline: Unai Emery Explains Alejandro Garnacho Exclusion From Aston Villa
seoTitle: Unai Emery Explains Alejandro Garnacho Villa Exclusion
metaDescription: Aston Villa manager Unai Emery stated that Alejandro Garnacho's omission from the matchday squad is due to team competition rather than discipline.
aiSummaryBullets: Manager Unai Emery attributed Alejandro Garnacho's squad exclusion to high competition within the Aston Villa team.
Emery dismissed reports of disciplinary issues, noting that he is pleased with the Chelsea loanee's attitude.
The manager's comments follow recent social media activity where the player removed Aston Villa references from his profile.
aiContextParagraph: Alejandro Garnacho, currently on loan from Chelsea to Aston Villa, was recently excluded from the club's matchday squad. This decision led to public discussion, further amplified after the player removed references to Aston Villa from his personal Instagram account. Addressing the situation, Aston Villa manager Unai Emery clarified that the decision to leave the player out was purely tactical. Emery emphasized that the move was not related to any internal disciplinary problems or a falling out with the athlete. Instead, the manager cited the high level of competition for positions within the squad as the primary driver behind his selection choices. Emery also highlighted that he remains satisfied with the player's professional attitude and conduct during training sessions, providing an official explanation amidst ongoing speculation regarding the loan spell.
whyItIsViral: This story is circulating following comments from the Aston Villa manager after reports of the player's recent social media activity.
